mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.owner_id, o.name AS owner_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM group_member m WHERE m.group_id = g.id) AS member_count FROM groups g JOIN users o ON o.id = g.owner_id WHERE g.id = #{groupId} AND g.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.name, u.email, u.work_phone, u.id = g.owner_id AS owner, m.joined_at FROM group_member m JOIN groups g ON g.id = m.group_id JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY m.joined_at, u.id

SELECT h.user_id, CASE WHEN u.deleted_at IS NULL THEN u.name ELSE #{withdrawnName} END AS user_name, h.type, h.actor_id, CASE WHEN a.deleted_at IS NULL THEN a.name ELSE #{withdrawnName} END AS actor_name, h.occurred_at FROM group_member_history h JOIN users u ON u.id = h.user_id JOIN users a ON a.id = h.actor_id WHERE h.group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY h.occurred_at, h.id
SELECT i.id, i.email, i.expires_at FROM invitation i WHERE i.group_id = #{groupId} AND i.status = 'PENDING' AND i.expires_at > #{now} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.id

SELECT i.id, g.id AS group_id, g.name AS group_name, u.name AS inviter_name, i.expires_at FROM invitation i JOIN groups g ON g.id = i.group_id JOIN users u ON u.id = i.inviter_id WHERE i.email = #{email} AND i.status = 'PENDING' AND i.expires_at > #{now} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND g.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.id
